meta.parties: Fernando Et Al. v. Cannangara Et Al

rules.statement: A gift to minor children by a parent is not invalid merely because the donees are infant children of the donor, but acceptance must still be proven.
rules.supporting_quote: "These children were one and all incompetent to accept this gift. As I said before, the deed professed to surrender itself and the title deeds to one of the children. Now, the case for the plaintiff was that the fifth plaintiff accepted the gift for the children."
